name: Pico CSS
title: picocss.com
shortDescription: Pico CSS is a minimalist and lightweight CSS framework designed for semantic HTML. It enhances HTML elements to be responsive and elegant by default without the need for extensive class usage. Ideal for developers seeking a clean design system, Pico CSS simplifies web styling by applying direct styles to HTML tags and offering a class-less version for purists. An example use case is building a responsive website quickly with semantic HTML and minimal CSS.
cons: Limited styling options compared to larger frameworks
May not suit complex web applications
Less community support than more popular frameworks
